drawback: Newer model with fewer ratings than the Sony.
buy_if: You want long battery life with noise cancelling for less than the Sony.

why_1: A long-running studio standard for mixing, editing video and recording.
why_2: 92% of 27,500 Amazon ratings are 4–5★, the best ratio in this guide.
drawback: Coiled wired cable and no mic; not meant for commuting.
buy_if: You edit audio or video or record music and need accurate sound.

why_1: Comfortable memory-foam gaming headset with virtual 7.1 surround for PC and PS5.
drawback: Some buyers say the detachable mic is average.
buy_if: You game for long hours and want a comfortable, durable headset.

why_1: Among the best noise cancelling and call quality available, now ₹12,000 cheaper than the newer XM6.
drawback: Doesn't fold flat; the XM6 has slightly better ANC.
buy_if: You fly or commute daily and want top noise cancelling without paying ₹40,000.

why_1: Very light clamp and soft pads for long flights, with strong Bose noise cancelling.
drawback: 24 hours of battery is less than rivals; costs the same as the Sony XM5.
buy_if: Comfort over many hours matters most to you.

why_1: Sony ANC with extra bass and 50 hours of battery for about half the XM5's price.
drawback: Bass-heavy sound isn't for everyone; ANC is a step below the XM5.
buy_if: You love bass and want premium ANC around ₹15,000.

why_1: 50 hours of battery with ANC, Sennheiser tuning and a 2-year warranty.
drawback: ANC is weaker than Sony and Bose flagships.
buy_if: You want balanced sound and long battery and value the longer warranty.

why_1: Lag-free 2.4GHz wireless gaming with a light suspension headband and good mic.
drawback: No Bluetooth; battery around 20–29 hours with lights on.
buy_if: You game on PC or PS5 and want to get rid of cables.

why_1: Sony's newest flagship with the strongest noise cancelling and calls in this guide, and it folds again.
drawback: ₹12,000 more than the XM5 for a modest upgrade.
buy_if: You want the very best and price is not a concern.

why_1: Bassy sound and a working mic for ₹349, from a brand with wide service coverage.
drawback: Average build; needs a 3.5mm jack, which many new phones lack.
buy_if: Your phone or laptop has a 3.5mm jack and you want cheap, reliable earphones.

why_1: Type-C plug for phones without a headphone jack, with in-line mic, for ₹323.
drawback: Build feels cheap according to several buyers; about 13% are 1–2★.
buy_if: Your phone has no 3.5mm jack and you want the cheapest wired option.

why_1: Type-C earphones with in-line controls from boAt for ₹489.
drawback: About 14% of ratings are 1–2★; some say they stopped working within months.
buy_if: You want Type-C earphones and prefer boAt's service network.

why_1: JBL tuning, angled earbuds for comfort and a metal finish for ₹749.
drawback: Some buyers say it sounds no better than cheaper earphones; 3.5mm only.
buy_if: You want trusted-brand wired earphones for calls and music.

why_1: In-ear monitor with a detachable cable and much clearer sound than typical ₹800 earphones.
drawback: KZ is sold through importers, so service is limited; one buyer got a box without ear tips.
buy_if: You listen closely to music and want the best detail for under ₹1,000.

why_1: Neckband with 32 hours of battery, AI ENC for calls and 45ms low latency for ₹1,199.
drawback: No ANC; neckbands are bulkier than earbuds in a pocket.
buy_if: You want wireless earphones you can't lose and that last all day.

why_1: 10-minute charge gives 27 hours of playback, with OnePlus tuning and 12.4mm drivers.
why_2: 80% of 2.3 lakh Amazon ratings are 4–5★ (rating shared with the Z2).
drawback: No ANC; about 13% of ratings are 1–2★.
buy_if: You want a dependable everyday neckband with very fast charging.

why_1: 50dB active noise cancelling in a neckband with 38 hours of playback and dual-device connection.
drawback: About 14% of ratings are 1–2★.
buy_if: You commute by bus or metro and want noise cancelling in a neckband.

why_1: Clear call mic and plug-and-play with USB-C iPhones, iPads and Android phones.
drawback: Open-fit design blocks no outside noise and has light bass; out of stock on Amazon.
buy_if: You use a USB-C iPhone and want reliable wired earphones for calls.
